title: Your apps, even offline
body: Shoal remembers the last checked releases when offline or Data Saver pauses checks. Already downloaded APKs can be installed offline after the usual signature checks. New downloads respect Wi-Fi-only settings and Data Saver throughout the transfer.

title: Know what changed
body: Shoal now shows release notes once after each app update. Open them again in Settings whenever you like.

title: Works offline
body: The notes are included with your installed version, with no extra network requests.
